tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders should read all the items specification and units in the tender documents before submitting the bid.
Bidder has to quote rates excluding GST, GST shall be paid separately as per applicable
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever.
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake
Turnover certificate from CA with valid UDIN No. to be furnished along with necessary documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have experience in the field for at least 2 years in the last five years (i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26) and should provide documentary evidence of similar products for 02 similar events

Mandating satisfactory completed as a prime contractor/Firm/Agency/supplier for at least one similar service of stage erection, instalment of stalls & Installation and operation of light and Sound system for any government sponsored Utsav s organised to an extent of Rs 30.00 Lakhs
The bidder should have firm/ company/ GST registration certificate

Achieved at least any one financial years from 2021-2022 to 2025-26 an average annual financial turnover of Rs 60.00 Lakh.(Certified turnover certificate issued by the Chartered accountant with UDIN Number)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The contractor should have liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs10.00Lakh (Unconditional Credit line/Letter of credit/Certificates from Banks for meeting the fund requirement etc)
